about_the_game:
All aboard! Leave navigation to the experts while your heroes rest between dungeons (or solve a murder mystery) thanks to the KR Vintage Steam Train Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another transportation themed MV/MZ-sized tileset to help your heroes get around a large world. Add some train tracks to all of your cities and turn fast travel points into awesome steam trains that roll into town with intricate red and gray locomotives and a long train of passenger cars. Create side quests where your heroes need to keep a train safe while it’s transporting fuel or important NPCs, or just let your heroes wander carriage interiors to choose whether to fully heal with a nap in bunk beds or gain a buff by eating some tasty food in the meal car.

A2, A4, B and C sheet tiles are perfect for making wooden carriages with soft green carpets leading your heroes to their seats with metal storage racks about their heads, or follow the rugs farther to reach separate compartments where small tables can hold suitcases and bunk beds are built into the walls. If your heroes snuck onto a train instead, have them hide out behind wooden crates and barrels in the stark metal cargo cars. This pack also includes 11 character sheets to help you add moving trains to your maps. Have the locomotive engine, tanker cars, wood cars, cargo cars, and passenger cars travel in the cardinal directions to show how connected your game’s world is, and use the wooden doors to keep your heroes from entering other people’s compartments before a passenger is murdered. Pick up the KR Vintage Steam Train Tileset pack and let your heroes travel comfortably!


The Vintage Steam Train Set Includes:

Animated train cars:

locomotive, passenger, cargo, tanker, wood car
up/down + left/right animations
Check sample maps for proper car spacing!

Floor tiles:

8 types of wood panel flooring (4 dark, 4 light, some with trim, north/south and east/west patterns.)
2 decorative wood floors
3 rugs
3 grates/metal floors for cargo areas

Wall tiles:

Wood panel walls in two colors
Walls with customizable windows. Includes night sky, day sky, and cloudy sky.
3 metal walls

Interior furniture:

ladder
adjustable table
chairs in multiple directions
place settings/food
adjustable curtains
another style of window
doors
barrels and crates
train tracks
luggage racks with luggage
modular bedding system with staircase, cabinets, two bunks, and privacy curtains
and more!

Other animations:

Two colors of animated door, with dark, light, and transparent floor (for interior use).

MV Sample map is included!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
